sources.aim_line: Reference line of the shot-shape views: finish (ball to where the ball finishes, the rest point when a roll is modelled, so a draw or fade that ends on target reads as on target), address (the address target line) or auto (finish when --shot-shape was asked for, address otherwise; without a shot shape the picture is unchanged). --aim-line overrides it.
sources.finish_text: HUD and plan-view label when the finish line is the reference.
sources.address_text: HUD and plan-view label when the address target line is the reference.
sources.line_color_rgba: Colour and opacity of the aim line drawn on the ground of the fixed views.
sources.line_width_px: Width of the aim line in pixels.
sources.overshoot_fraction: How far the drawn aim line runs past the finish point, as a fraction of the ball-to-finish distance, so the finish does not sit on the line's end.
sources.min_finish_distance_m: Shortest ball-to-finish distance (metres) that defines a direction; a ball that finishes closer keeps the address line, since its direction is noise.
